description: Compare parallel design alternatives side by side on the same measures. Pass `paths` to two or more alternative export documents (branch-by-file); the first is the baseline. On a registry server, give `other_graph_ids` instead of paths, measured against this design. Returns each branch's measures — design nodes, open gaps, structural defects, allocation modularity, capabilities verified — plus each non-baseline branch's structural divergence from the baseline. It opens its own throwaway graphs and never touches the live one. Collapse the winner with merge_designs/apply_merge and retire the losers. Ask for this to line candidate designs up on the same numbers.

other_graph_ids.description:
The alternatives BY GRAPH_ID, on a server that holds many designs (a
registry behind a trusted host): the live graph is the baseline,
labelled by this design's graph_id, and each alternative is read from
the design the server already holds, inside the set of designs the host
says you may read. One or more; not combined with `paths`; refused on a
single-design server.

paths.description:
Paths to the alternative design exports (branch-by-file). The first is
the baseline the others' divergence is reported against. Two or more.
Required unless `other_graph_ids` is passed.

name: analyze_alternatives
